name: @skojaku/pi-pair-notebook
description: A Socratic tutor that pairs with a student inside a marimo notebook: a pi extension with an nb_* toolkit, chapter orchestration, checkpoint ceremony, a verbatim session log, and a referee the student can appeal to. Ships the installer the student runs before pi exists, and the harness that reviews a module.
author: Sadamori Kojaku <skojaku@binghamton.edu>
//scripts: node --test needs no dependencies and no build step: node 24 strips the
types itself, and extensions/lib/*.ts is written to be importable by both
the test runner and pi's own loader (jiti). `npm test` from a fresh clone

//extensions: Order matters. channel-update.ts is loaded SECOND so notebook-tool.ts is
already imported before it can check a different tag out from under the
loader. pi's loader catches per extension path, so the second entry still
runs when the first one throws — which is the whole point of it being a

//peerDependenciesMeta: Optional so that npm does not install them. pi bundles all four and
resolves them for the extension itself; npm 7+ otherwise auto-installs
peers, and the pi SDK pulls every provider SDK with it — 236 MB of
node_modules per student, per module clone, for code that is never read.
